Isolotto Nord — Florence, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

As with neighbouring Isolotto Sud, the Isolotto public-housing district has seen genuine documented gang-related incidents in 2025-2026, including an armed confrontation with shots fired and a 2026 knife attack on a father in front of his young son during a robbery attempt. Local press generally refers simply to 'the Isolotto' without distinguishing the Nord and Sud administrative sub-zones, so the same honest caveat applies here: the specific sub-zone of these incidents is not identified in press coverage. Sources checked: La Nazione, 'Firenze, follia maranza: agguato con la pistola, sei spari in piazza' (Isolotto); Il Fatto Quotidiano, father stabbed by baby gang in front of son at Isolotto (April 2026).
